meta.title: First vendor to accept closes the auction and is awarded
gaps: Select or guarantee a live Dutch auction as the starting event.
Verify that the accepting vendor is specifically awarded the bid.
Sign in as another vendor and verify that other vendors can no longer accept.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select or guarantee a live Dutch auction as the starting event.; Verify that the accepting vendor is specifically awarded the bid.; Sign in as another vendor and verify that other vendors can no longer accept.

steps.note: Open the closest existing live event available; the catalog cannot constrain this selection to a Dutch auction.
Act as the invited vendor who should accept the current offer.
Open the event's pricing round in the supplier portal.
Assert that the vendor portal exposes the acceptance control.
Accept the current offer as the vendor.
Check the generic outcome text for the auction closing after acceptance.
Return to the buyer console to inspect the event outcome.
Check for a generic awarded indicator, although the catalog has no domain assertion tying it to the accepting vendor.
